grammar.label: articles with abstract and generic nouns
grammar.meaning: talking about something in general rather than a particular one

explanation.en: Use no article for a plural or uncountable noun meant generally: 'Money isn't everything', 'Children learn fast'. Add 'the' only for a specific set.
explanation.uz: Umumiy ma'noda ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan ot artiklsiz keladi: 'Money isn't everything'. 'the' faqat aniq guruh uchun qo'shiladi.

grammar.positive_example: Books are expensive here. The books on that shelf are mine.
grammar.negative_example: The books are expensive here in general.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida artikl yo'q, shuning uchun o'quvchi 'the' ni ortiqcha qo'yadi yoki umuman tashlab ketadi.

grammar.label: quantifiers — plenty of, a great deal of, hardly any

explanation.en: 'Plenty of' means more than enough. 'Hardly any' means almost none. Some quantifiers take countable nouns, others uncountable.
explanation.uz: 'plenty of' — yetarlidan ko'p. 'hardly any' — deyarli yo'q. Ba'zilari sanaladigan, ba'zilari sanalmaydigan ot bilan keladi.

grammar.positive_example: There is plenty of room, but hardly any chairs.

body.text: The clinics are good. Money is the problem, not the doctors.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Most of my friends would say things have improved a lot.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: A few would disagree. Inequality has grown at the same time.
